def transform(grid):
    """Expand the seed into a downward V, then fill an interior diagonal stripe."""
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        left, right = max(0, center - r), min(n - 1, center + r)
        if r <= center:
            out[r][center - r] = 2
            out[r][center + r] = 2
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            if out[r][c] != 2 and (c - r - center) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
PY
